data.name: Nawwa
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'anewa', meaning 'she who gives'. In Islamic tradition, Nawwa is the name of a female saint who was known for her charitable deeds and generosity.

in_arabic.name: نَوۡوَ
in_arabic.long_meaning: النعم: من الفعل نعمى، والكامِل: من الكَمال، والَسَعادة: من السَعَدَة، والإِستِحسان: من الإِستِحسَن، والإِعجاب: من الإِعجَب. ومعناه في القرآن الكريم: نعماء، كَمال، سَعادة، إِستِحسان، وإِعجاب، ويكون للإنسان نعماءً في الدين، كَمالَ في الأعمال، سَعادةً في الدُنيا، إِستِحسانَ في العبادات، وإِعجابَ في الحِداة.

in_urdu.name: نَوۡوَ
in_urdu.long_meaning: نوں سے تعلق رکھنے والی چیزوں کا نام ہے۔ قرآن میں اس کا مطلب ہے خوشی، کمال، خوشی، پسندیدگی، شگفتگی۔ انسان کے لئے دین میں نعماء ہے۔ دکھاوے میں کمال ہے۔ دنیا میں خوشی ہے۔ عبادت میں پسندیدگی ہے۔ ہدایت میں شگفتگی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नव्वा
in_hindi.long_meaning: नव्वा शुभा, शुद्धता, सुख, संतुष्टि, प्रसन्नता का अर्थ है। कुरआन में इसका अर्थ है शुभा, शुद्धता, सुख, संतुष्टि, प्रसन्नता।มนुष्य के लिए यह अर्थ है - दीन में शुभा, देखावे में शुद्धता, दुनिया में सुख, इबादत में संतुष्टि, हिदायत में प्रसन्नता।

in_english.name: Nawwa
in_english.meaning: the best, perfection, happiness, satisfaction, admiration
in_english.long_meaning: Nawwa (the best, perfection, happiness, satisfaction, admiration) is a name derived from the Arabic root n-w-w, which means to praise or to admire. In the Quran, Nawwa refers to the best of things, perfection, happiness, satisfaction, and admiration. For a person, Nawwa means to be the best in faith, to be perfect in deeds, to be happy in the world, to be satisfied in worship, and to be admired in guidance.

It symbolizes the selfless attitude that a generous person should possess, inspiring those around them to be more giving and compassionate. Furthermore, it strengthens the communal bond in Muslim societies by emphasizing the collective responsibility of contributing to the welfare of others.

Nawwa's generosity and giving nature is a reflection of Allah's mercy and kindness towards His creation. As Muslims strive to emulate these virtues, the name Nawwa can serve as a constant reminder and motivation to be more giving, more compassionate, and more charitable in their actions.
